insight: There's been no rain at all lately, so stormwater runoff isn't a factor right now. The model's main signals right now: high tide level is raising risk — a high tide can mobilize bacteria held in wet sand and push the waterline toward outfalls; no rain has fallen, so nothing is washing off the land into the surf; and tidal range is raising risk — large tidal swings resuspend bacteria stored in sediment and wet sand.
